category_title: Blind student with selective mutism and high receptive language skills
scenario_title: Listening comprehension questions with Braille and voice-output device
minimal_context: Sally is using a voice-output device to answer listening comprehension questions after reading a story in Braille.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We just finished the story. Now I am going to ask you a comprehension question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sally finishes tactually tracking the Braille lines with the fingertips of both hands.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the voice-output device. Did the main character go to the store? Press yes or no.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sally independently places her hand on the communicator.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What is your answer? Go ahead and press a button.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sally hesitates after placing her hand on the communicator, remaining silent and not pressing a response.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We just finished the story. Now I am going to ask you a comprehension question.

STUDENT: (Sally finishes tactually tracking the Braille lines with the fingertips of both hands.)

STUDENT: (Sally independently places her hand on the communicator.)

TUTOR: What is your answer? Go ahead and press a button.

STUDENT: (Sally hesitates after placing her hand on the communicator, remaining silent and not pressing a response.)

task.content: Listened to a story while tactually tracking the Braille lines with the fingertips of both hands. Afterwards, she was asked a series of comprehension questions.
task.learning_goal: Independently pressing a response to a listening comprehension question

context.materials: Braille lines, voice-output device, M&M reinforcer
context.time_context: After Sally completed her preferred activity

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: After independently placing her hand on the communicator

behavior_patterns.condition: If she answered the question incorrectly
